name: Aushopping
verdict: Network of Auchan shopping centres in France, run by Nhood Services France; Nhood belongs to New Immo Holding, an ELO company held by the Mulliez family association. Nothing found.
note: Chain: Nhood Services France (publisher of aushopping.com) → New Immo Holding → ELO (family and employee shareholders) → Association Famille Mulliez. No state or state fund in the chain.
